items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I don't know him. ... Well I heard of him and in fact I saw him one time on the street.

ctx.x: Were you ever in that WPA band, that big band? No, no, no, I never did get a chance of that.
Did you go over all the other old time drummers like Henry Zeno? That's too far back. Is that too far back? No, I don't know him. That old man Cottrell, did you hear him?
